rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person or animal that obeys instructions and does what it is told.

example.english: This dog is very docile; when you tell it to sit, it sits right away.
example.traditional: 呢隻狗好聽話嘅，叫佢坐低就即刻坐低。
example.jyutping: nei1 zek3 gau2 hou2 teng1 waa6 ge3 giu3 keoi5 co5 dai1 zau6 zik1 hak1 co5 dai1

rows.note: Use this for the gentle, mild-tempered side of docility, especially when someone or an animal is easy to handle rather than merely following a particular instruction.

example.english: That cat is very docile; even when I hold it to trim its nails, it doesn’t struggle.
example.traditional: 嗰隻貓好溫順嘅，抱住佢剪指甲都唔會掙扎。
example.jyutping: go2 zek3 maau1 hou2 wan1 seon6 ge3 pou5 zyu6 keoi5 zin2 zi2 gaap3 dou1 m4 wui5 zang1 zaat3
